errorCodes.meaning: No member with the supplied did exists.
The presentation's challenge is unknown or expired. Open a new personhood/challenge.
The Verifiable Presentation failed verification, its holder did not match did, or it did not satisfy the community's active personhood policy.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

personhood.description: Always true on success — the flag flipped or stayed asserted.

roleVac.description: Re-issued role credential (opaque here): a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues.

vmc.description: Re-issued membership credential carrying the asserted personhood (opaque here).

did.description: The member asserting personhood; MUST equal the presentation's holder.

presentation.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation (opaque here). Its holder MUST match did, its proof.challenge MUST be the paired challengeId, and it MUST carry at least one credential satisfying the community's active personhood policy.
